title: Phase 1: Order Events
goal: Read the stream, materialize the order, and know the stock as a ledger.
unlocks: An order record and a stock position to decide on.

title: Phase 2: Inventory
goal: Reserve what is truly available, backorder the rest, and reorder when the position drops.

title: Phase 3: Fulfillment States
goal: Walk each order through its legal states as events arrive.
unlocks: Orders shipped with tracking, illegal events refused.

title: Phase 4: Exceptions and Compensation
goal: Undo a failed shipment properly and confirm the ones that arrive.
unlocks: Honest final states for every order.

title: Phase 5: Confirmation and Replenishment
goal: Count the day for Ops and keep the history that tunes the reorder points.
unlocks: The 6:00 PM digest and tomorrow's demand history.
